items.name: The Author's Pen
items.description: It still remembers how it all began.

items.name: Perfect Blank Page
items.description:
Untouched, unfolded and unafraid. The rarest thing a Storytender can find.
Nothing has ever gone wrong on this page.

items.name: Bookworm Charm
items.description: He eats the boring parts for you.

items.name: Cartographer's Compass
items.description: Always points to the next interesting thing.

items.name: Censor's Monocle
items.description: Confiscated, then polished.

items.name: Clarity Tonic
items.description:
Refills the Lantern and restores some ink.
Tastes like clean punctuation.

items.name: Cloth Binding
items.description: Plain, sturdy, quietly hopeful.

items.name: Pressed Clover
items.description:
A flat four-leaf clover from between two pages.
Found at page 212. Kept for luck.

items.name: Dust Jacket
items.description: Slides off easily. So do you.

items.name: The Eternal Bookmark
items.description: Marks the place where you decided to keep going.

items.name: Ghost Pepper Ink
items.description:
Scares nearby Errors into freezing for a few seconds.
Do not taste it. We mean it.

items.name: Ghostwriter's Glove
items.description: It wrote this item description.

items.name: Glue Stub
items.description:
The dried end of a paste stick. Holds things together, mostly.
The sticky truth.

items.name: Gold Leaf
items.description:
A whisper-thin sheet of gold for illuminating things.
Do not sneeze.

items.name: The Golden Ratio
items.description: Perfectly proportioned. Perfectly smug.

items.name: Herbal Tea
items.description:
Restores a little ink and a little Lantern.
Steeped in the margins of a quiet chapter.

items.name: Honey Biscuit
items.description:
Restores some ink.
Pip hid these in every pocket.

items.name: Hourglass of Drafts
items.description: Every grain is a version you did not publish.

items.name: Illuminated Binding
items.description: Every margin glows with someone's patience.

items.name: Ink Blot
items.description:
A droplet of ink that never dried.
It looks a little like a face. Do not look too long.

items.name: Lamplighter's Match
items.description: Never goes out. Never asks for credit.

items.name: Library Binding
items.description: Reinforced to survive a thousand borrowers.

items.name: Loose Thread
items.description:
Pull it and a whole sentence unravels. Useful for binding.
Do not pull it. Everyone pulls it.

items.name: Lucky Clover
items.description: Four leaves. Someone got to the fifth and stopped.

items.name: Margin Doodle
items.description: A small sword, drawn with enthusiasm.

items.name: Marginalia Dust
items.description:
Glittering dust brushed from forgotten notes.
Someone wrote 'yes!!' here and no one remembers why.

items.name: Memory Jar
items.description:
Break it open for 60 Mnemosynth.
Someone kept these on a shelf for a rainy day.

items.name: Midnight Inkwell
items.description: Never empties while you are still writing.

items.name: Paper Clip
items.description: Holds it all together, barely.

items.name: Paper Scrap
items.description:
A torn corner of something that used to matter.
Every book is made of these, eventually.

items.name: Pencil Shaving
items.description:
A curl of cedar that still smells like a first draft.
Sharpened, then forgotten.

items.name: Phoenix Draught
items.description:
Restores all ink and fully refuels the Lantern.
Burns going down. Starts you over.

items.name: Phoenix Ember
items.description:
A coal from a story that kept getting rewritten.
It always starts again.

items.name: Pocket Workbench
items.description:
A folding bench, a tiny vice and a surprising number of pliers. Use it from the Binder to craft anywhere.
Every lantern post has a bench. This one has legs.

items.name: Quill Feather
items.description:
A long primary feather, cut for writing.
From a bird that had a lot to say.

items.name: Reader's Digest
items.description:
A pocket summary of your deeds. Grants 12 Renown.
Condensed, with notes.

items.name: Reading Glasses
items.description: Now you can see the small print. And the big threats.

items.name: Rubber Band
items.description: Snaps back. Mostly.

items.name: Silver Ribbon
items.description: Tied around the last page of a love letter.

items.name: Silver Thread
items.description:
Thread spun from moonlit margins. Strong and bright.
It hums when you hold it.

items.name: Time in a Bottle
items.description:
Freezes every nearby Error for a long breath.
Stopped at 4:17, a Tuesday.

items.name: Tin Bell
items.description: Rings when trouble is polite enough to knock.

items.name: The Unwritten Word
items.description:
A single word nobody has used yet. Heavier than it looks.
It is on the tip of the world's tongue.

items.name: Vellum Binding
items.description: Older than the story it holds.

items.name: Void Pearl
items.description:
A pearl of pure redaction. Cold and perfectly round.
It swallows light, and a little bit of you.

items.name: Wax Seal
items.description:
A red seal that once closed an important letter.
It was not that important.

items.name: The Bookmark
items.description:
Lets you return to a place you have restored.
A promise to return to this moment.

items.name: Bookmark Charm
items.description:
Your ink slowly refills on its own (0.8 per second).
Wherever you stopped, it keeps your place.

items.name: Eraser Crumbs
items.description:
Throw it. Rubs out Errors in a small radius (5 damage).
Everything starts as a mistake someone rubbed out.

items.name: The First Edition
items.description:
-10% damage taken, +10% Quill damage, a little ink regeneration and extra grace after a hit.
Every story starts as someone's first try. This one got it nearly right.

items.name: The Footnote
items.description:
Your Quill reaches 20% further.
Small, numbered, and surprisingly far-reaching.

items.name: Gilded Binding
items.description:
A collector's binding. -15% damage taken, +10% speed, faster dash, +15% Quill damage.
Too nice to read. You read it anyway.

items.name: Hardcover Binding
items.description:
Heavy plates cut from book covers. -30% damage taken, but slower.
You can judge it by its cover. Everyone does.

items.name: The Highlighter
items.description:
The Lantern burns 35% slower.
It makes the important parts glow, and the rest less important.

items.name: Index Tab
items.description:
Your dash recovers 20% faster.
Always one flick from the page you need.

items.name: Ink Flask
items.description:
Restores all of your ink.
Bottled by someone who knew you would need it.

items.name: Ink Vial
items.description:
Restores a good measure of ink.
Still wet.

items.name: Lantern Oil
items.description:
Refills the Lantern completely.
Smells like warm paper and good intentions.

items.name: Leatherbound Binding
items.description:
Fine leather, gold edges. -20% damage taken and +10% Quill damage.
It smells like an old library and a good decision.

items.name: Margin Note
items.description:
-10% damage taken.
'Be careful here.'  (Underlined twice.)

items.name: The Oxford Comma
items.description:
A pause before you take the next hit: a little extra grace after being struck.
A small pause, and all the difference.

items.name: Paperback Binding
items.description:
Cheap, light and quick. +20% speed, but -5% protection.
Read it until the spine cracks.

items.name: The Red Pen
items.description:
+25% Quill damage.
Strike it out. Strike it all out.

items.name: Softcover Binding
items.description:
Light, flexible leather. +12% speed, faster dash, -10% damage taken.
Dog-eared. Loved.

items.name: Sticky Note
items.description:
Sticks every Error nearby to the page for a few seconds. They cannot move, and a hit on one counts as a sneak attack.
Reminder: do not be eaten.

items.name: The Tailor's Thimble
items.description:
A small, dented thimble. -8% damage taken and a faster dash.
Made to push the needle through, so the sewing could keep going.

items.name: The Torn Page
items.description:
The last page of Pip's storybook, torn out and hidden. It fits the door to the final room.
He tore it out so no one could spoil it. Then he spoiled it himself.

items.name: Void Ink
items.description:
A crafting material scraped from the Redaction.
It stains your fingers with bad memories.

items.name: Warm Loaf
items.description:
Restores a good deal of ink.
Still warm. Someone made it for you.
